description: Read discussion threads and draft review notes on merge requests. Actions: list (all threads with resolution status), drafts (unpublished draft notes), draft (single draft details). Related: manage_mr_discussion to comment, manage_draft_notes to create drafts.

action.description: Action to perform: list, drafts, draft

draft_note_id.description: Unique identifier of the draft note Required for 'draft' action(s).

merge_request_iid.description: Internal MR ID unique to project

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list' action(s).

name: browse_mr_discussions
